        internal class Resource : IDisposable
        {
            internal Resource()
            {
            }

            public virtual void Dispose()
            {
                Console.WriteLine("closed");
            }
        }

        internal abstract class Shape : IComparable<Shape>
        {
            internal Shape()
            {
            }

            internal abstract double area();

            public virtual int CompareTo(Shape o)
            {
                return JavaRt.CompareDouble(area(), o.area());
            }

            public override string ToString()
            {
                return "Shape(" + JavaRt.Str(area()) + ")";
            }
        }

        internal sealed class Square : Shape
        {
            internal double side;

            internal Square(double side)
            {
                this.side = side;
            }

            internal override double area()
            {
                return side * side;
            }

            public override bool Equals(object o)
            {
                return o is Square && ((Square)o).side == side;
            }

            public override int GetHashCode()
            {
                return (int)side;
            }
        }

            {
            }

            public abstract string greet(string name);

            internal Polite()
            {

            public override string greet(string name)

                return "hello " + JavaRt.Str(name);
            }
        }
